intro.text: A professor and scientist in the Set, where he holds the rank of Array; a Leecher who walks with a cane because a wasting illness is slowly killing him.

items.text: Irich was part of the Set's attack on the train carrying Wax and his companions. Running into Marasi, he fled and dropped the cube device he carried, which Marasi picked up and found could extend a person's Allomancy.

At Dulsing he leads the academics studying a strange wrecked ship whose means of moving no one can explain. His superiors want a weapon from it, but Irich, feeling his body fail, hopes instead for a miracle that could save his life.

appearance.text: Thin and about six feet tall, with a narrow face and dark hair. He leans on a cane and stoops, which makes him look older than he is.

personality.text: He cares nothing for the rank and power he holds in the Set, since neither can lengthen his life.
